Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
vampire A is acting.

B and C are tapped. B plays forced awakening and attempts to block.
block is successful. C then plays Forced Awakening to play Shilmulo
Deception.

I presume neither B nor C needs to burn a blood for forced awakening,
as they both successfully blocked?

Does the 'not usable...cards that this vampire could not play' text on
Shilmulo mean that, as you can't play the same reaction card twice on
an action, and B played a Forced awakening, then when C plays _his_
forced awakening, it is affected by this clause?

Also, I assume you can chain a few Shilmulo's together during a
successful block? (ie: A blocks. B shilmulo's. C shilmulo's. D
shilmulo's and finally gets to fight the acting minion).

Forced Awakening [Sabbat:C, SW:C/PB2/PT5/PV2, FN:PA2/PS2, CE:PTr4,
BH:PM3/PTr4]
Cardtype: Reaction
Only usable by a tapped vampire.
This reacting vampire can attempt to block and play reaction cards as
though untapped. If he or she does not successfully block this action,
he or she burns an additional blood.

Shilmulo Deception [FN:C2]
Cardtype: Reaction
Discipline: Chimerstry
[chi] Only usable when a minion you control successfully blocks (play
before combat). Not usable if the blocking minion played any reaction
cards that this vampire could not play. Do not tap the blocking
minion; tap this reacting vampire instead. Now this vampire is the
blocking vampire (and combat begins as normal).
[CHI] As above, and this vampire gets an optional maneuver during the
first round of the resulting combat.
